name: t0/greedy
why: Greedy on both arms. Q8_0 exists to test whether GLM-4.7-Flash's Q4_K_S GGUF was quantisation damage: that build scores 5/104 with reasoning off and 0/104 at 4x budget. Greedy thinking has aborted on every GLM build so far (MLX 46h, Q4_K_S 87h); if it aborts here too that is the model, and this time the evidence is not from a broken file.
